title: SideStripped
description: A simple Paper plugin that prevents players from stripping logs and replaces it with a crafting recipe instead.
body:
This plugin is for Paper servers, and it does one simple thing: it prevents players from accidentally stripping logs.

Ever gone to open a door with an axe in your hand, clicked the side of your beautiful house, and stripped a log by mistake? This fixes that. Stripping logs is moved to the crafting table instead, where it now requires 2 logs to craft 2 stripped logs.

The action bar message is fully configurable, and you can also disable specific log types if you want.

Thanks for checking it out!
